column3: You're drowning. And the last thing you want to do is ask anyone for help.
Maybe you don't want to be a burden. Maybe you think they'll say no. Maybe you've carried it alone for so long, you don't know another way.
One Piece has two of the most famous scenes in anime about exactly this. And the research on asking for help says we've got it backwards.
Today: why asking for help is so hard. And why you should do it anyway.
